EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Do you know about perfect fruit,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Every once in a while,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} there'll be
one slipped in{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} with the regular fruit
on a tree.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Once you've had one,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} you'll never
be able to forget that flavor.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}You should keep your eyes peeled
for perfect fruit!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu as déjà entendu parler des fruits
parfaits, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}C'est rare,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} mais de temps en temps,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
un fruit exceptionnel pousse parmi
les autres.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est un fruit parfait.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Quand tu en as goûté un,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} après tu te
souviens toujours de son arôme
délicat et de son goût unique.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Alors, regarde bien les fruits que tu
cueilles. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Si tu as de la chance, un
jour tu pourrais bien en trouver un.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hai sentito parlare del frutto
perfetto, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Di tanto in tanto,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ne troverai uno{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
tra la frutta normale degli alberi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Basta assaggiarne uno{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} per non
dimenticarne più il sapore.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Devi tenere gli occhi ben aperti:
non sai mai quando potresti
ritrovartene uno tra le mani!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Weißt du schon Bescheid über
1a-Früchte, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Die wachsen ab und zu am Baum
zwischen normalen Früchten.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Wenn du mal in so eine 1a-Frucht
reingebissen hast, willst du nie
wieder was anderes essen!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Also schau dir die Bäume genau an!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Mükemmel meyveyi biliyor musun,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Arada sırada,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ağaçtaki normal
meyvelerin arasına{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} bir tane karışır.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Bir kere tadına baktın mı,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} o lezzeti
bir daha unutamazsın.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Mükemmel meyve görürsen
gözünden kaçırma!

EN:
When you're collecting fruit,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} your
pockets fill up pretty fast, huh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}When that happens,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} you can group
similar types of fruit together in
your pockets to save space.
Try it out!
ES:
Cuando recoges fruta,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} los bolsillos
se te llenan muy rápido, ¿no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Para evitarlo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} puedes juntar
fruta que sea del mismo tipo
y ahorrar espacio. ¡Pruébalo!
FR:
Quand on cueille des fruits,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} les
poches se remplissent vite, pas
vrai ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le truc pour gagner de la place,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
c'est de regrouper les fruits de la
même sorte. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Essaie, tu verras.
IT:
Quando raccogli la frutta,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} le tue
tasche si riempiono in un lampo, eh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Come fare?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ti basterà raggruppare
più frutti dello stesso tipo nelle
tue tasche per risparmiare spazio.
Provaci!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Kennst du das auch –{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} die Taschen
voller Früchte, aber man braucht
unbedingt noch eine?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dann kann man in seinem Inventar
Früchte derselben Sorte einfach zu
Fruchtkörben zusammenlegen!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sofort hat man wieder Platz und
kann weiterpflücken wie wild!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Probier's doch mal aus!
TRANSLATION:
Meyve toplarken,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} ceplerin hemen doluyor,
değil mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Öyle olunca,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ceplerinde aynı
tür meyveleri üst üste koyup
yer kazanabilirsin.
Bir dene!

EN:
If you cut down a tree with an axe,
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}it leaves a stump, right?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I heard that sometimes{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} there are 
stumps with strange patterns on
'em,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}And sometimes next to those
strange stumps{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} you can find
rare mushrooms growing.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Rare mushrooms{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} I bet they taste
amazing,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Si talas un árbol con un hacha,
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}ves que deja un tocón, ¿no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}He oído que {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}hay algunos tocones
con formas extrañas,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}A veces junto a esos tocones
extraños {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}se pueden encontrar
unas setas muy raras.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Esas setas raras{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¡estoy seguro
de que tienen un sabor tremendo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
Se abbatti un albero con un'ascia,
non ti resta altro che il ceppo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho sentito che esistono{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ceppi
con strani disegni,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}E a volte accanto a questi strani
ceppi{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} puoi trovare dei funghi rari.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}I funghi rari{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Scommetto che sono
da leccarsi i baffi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Wenn man einen Baum umhackt,
bleibt doch ein Stumpf übrig,
oder?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hab gehört, dass es ab und zu
Stümpfe mit komischen Mustern
drauf gibt.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Und dass neben diesen komischen
Stümpfen manchmal total seltene
Pilze wachsen!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Seltene Pilze!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Die schmecken
bestimmt super auf der Pizza,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Bir ağacı baltayla kesince{{TAG:0003:0017:}} kütük
kalıyor, değil mi?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Duyduğuma göre bazen{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
üstünde tuhaf desenler olan kütükler
çıkıyormuş,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bir de o tuhaf
kütüklerin yanında{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} nadir mantarlar
yetişebiliyormuş.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Nadir mantarlar{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Kesin çok lezzetlidir,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}If you hit a rock{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} with an axe or
shovel, sometimes a bunch of
money comes out.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}The trick is to hit it really fast!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}If you hit it fast enough,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} lots of
money will come out!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}And you can actually combine the
money you pick up by going into
your pockets.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Actually, I need to practice my
rock hitting.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm too slow, so I never
make much money,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si le das a una roca{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} con
un hacha o una pala, a veces
aparecerá dinero.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡El truco es darle muy rápido!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Si le das lo bastante rápido,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡saldrá muchísimo dinero!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ah, y resulta que puedes juntar
el dinero en tus bolsillos.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Tengo que practicar con lo de
golpear rocas.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Como soy tan lento,
nunca consigo mucho dinero.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si tu tapes un rocher avec une
hache ou une pelle, des fois tu peux
trouver de l'argent. Tu le savais ?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}C'est dingue ! Le truc c'est de
frapper super vite, en fait,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oui ! Si tu cognes vraiment
rapidement,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il y aura plein de
clochettes qui en sortiront.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En plus, si tu les superposes toutes
dans ton inventaire, elles prendront
moins de place !
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Mais moi, je suis trop lent.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je
n'arrive pas à taper assez vite, alors
je ne ramasse pas grand-chose...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se colpisci una roccia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} con un'ascia
o una pala, a volte si possono
trovare tante stelline.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Il segreto è colpire velocemente!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Se sei molto veloce,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} potresti
trovare un sacco di stelline!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Purtroppo io sono un lumacone
quando si tratta di colpire le rocce.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}E così finisce che rimango sempre
a mani vuote,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn man Felsen mit der Schaufel
oder der Axt haut, kommen
manchmal Münzen raus.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Dann muss man ganz schnell hauen:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Zack! Zack! Zack!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Wenn man schnell
genug ist, knackt man den Jackpot!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Übrigens kann man im Inventar
einzelne Münzen zusammenlegen.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Dann platzen einem die Taschen
nicht so schnell, wenn man wieder
mal haufenweise Münzen abräumt!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Aber leider bin ich dafür immer
zu langsam,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir kayaya{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} balta ya da kürekle vurursan
bazen bir sürü para çıkar.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}İşin sırrı çok hızlı vurmak!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yeterince hızlı vurursan,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} daha çok para çıkar!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Topladığın paraları da ceplerini
açıp birleştirebilirsin.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Aslında benim kaya vurma çalışmam lazım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Çok yavaşım, o yüzden pek para
kazanamıyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
If you hit a rock{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} with an axe or
shovel, sometimes that rock will
crack open and reveal a treasure!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I just love treasure hunts,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Si le das a una roca{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} con un hacha
o una pala, ¡a veces esa roca se
partirá y encontrarás un tesoro!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Me encanta buscar tesoros,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Si tu frappes sur un rocher avec une
hache ou une pelle,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il se peut qu'il
éclate et que tu trouves un trésor !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Partir à la chasse au trésor dans
son jardin,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est pas dingue ça,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?!
IT:
Se colpisci una roccia{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} con un'ascia
o una pala, a volte la roccia si crepa
e spunta un tesoro!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Io adoro la caccia al tesoro,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Wenn man Felsen mit der Schaufel
oder der Axt haut, gehen sie ab und
zu kaputt und spucken Schätze aus!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich liiiebe Schätze,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Bir kayaya{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} balta ya da kürekle vurunca
bazen çatlayıp içindeki
hazineyi gösterir!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hazine avına bayılırım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}It sure seems like there are more
gyroids around on the days after
it rains.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}When it's sunny for a long time, you
can't find any at all.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}I guess gyroids
must like the rain,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Pues parece que es más fácil
encontrar giroides cuando
ha llovido.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Cuando está soleado durante mucho
tiempo, no encuentro ninguno.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Supongo que les gusta la lluvia...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Tu as remarqué qu'on trouve plus
facilement des gyroïdes après qu'il
a plu ?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Et comme par hasard, quand il fait
soleil pendant plusieurs jours, on
n'en voit plus du tout.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il faut croire que les gyroïdes
aiment la pluie,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Nelle giornate di pioggia, quando
smette di piovere, ci sono un sacco
di giroidi in giro.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Se invece fa bello per giorni e giorni
è impossibile riuscire a trovarli.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I giroidi devono essere amanti
della pioggia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Bilde ich es mir ein, oder sieht
man echt mehr Gyroiden, wenn es
am Tag zuvor geregnet hat?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Wenn es lange sonnig war, finde ich
nie welche.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vielleicht sind Gyroiden
wie Pilze und wachsen im Regen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Yağmurdan sonraki günlerde ortalıkta
daha çok gyroid oluyor gibi.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Uzun süre hava güneşliyse hiç
bulamıyorsun.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Galiba gyroidler yağmuru
seviyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
If you give {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Cyrus{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} at Re-Tail{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} a {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}gold
nugget{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}he'll make you some shiny
golden furniture!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Isn't that great? {{TAG:0003:0021:}}I'm gonna {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}try
my best to find some of those 
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}gold nuggets{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
ES:
Si le das un poco de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}oro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} a {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Al{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
el de la tienda de reciclaje,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡te hará
una pasada de muebles de oro!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¿A que suena genial?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Pienso{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} buscar bien a ver
si encuentro un poco de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}oro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
FR:
Si tu vas voir {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Serge {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}au magasin de
recyclage{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et que tu lui apportes des
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pépites d'or{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}...
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}... il te fabriquera un super meuble
doré ! {{TAG:0003:0004:}}C'est pas cool, ça,
peut-être ?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Moi, en tout cas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je vais tout faire
pour trouver quelques {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pépites d'or {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
IT:
Se porti dei {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}minerali d'oro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}a {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Merino
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}di Ricicla e Ricrea{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}ti costruirà
dei luccicanti mobili dorati!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Non è fantastico? {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Farò del mio{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
meglio per trovare un po'
di {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}minerali d'{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}oro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
DE:
Wenn man {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Björn{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} in der Fundgrube
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Golderz{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} gibt, {{TAG:0003:0005:}}bastelt er einem
echte Goldmöbel!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ist das nicht toll? {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ich mach mich
gleich mal auf die Suche nach
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Golderz{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
TRANSLATION:
Re-Tail’deki {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Cyrus{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}’a{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} bir {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}altın külçesi{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
verirsen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}sana parlak altın
mobilyalar yapar!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Harika değil mi? {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ben de o {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}altın
külçelerinden{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bulmak için elimden
geleni yapacağım!

ES:
Resulta que estaba sentado{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
delante del árbol de la plaza...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Y entonces empecé a recordar{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
el montón de cosas{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} que han
pasado en {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}¡Ese árbol{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} habrá visto de todo
a lo largo de su vida, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La próxima vez que quieras
descansar un ratito,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡tienes
que probar a sentarte allí!
FR:
J'étais tranquillement assis{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} au pied
de l'arbre qui donne sur la place...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Et tout d'un coup je me suis
souvenu de tout plein de trucs qui
me sont arrivés à {{TAG:0005:0005:}}.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Cet arbre doit en avoir vu des
choses{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} depuis qu'il est là,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si tu as envie de te souvenir de
bons moments,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je te conseille
d'aller t'y asseoir.
C'est un bon endroit pour se
replonger dans le passé.
IT:
Ero seduto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sotto l'albero
della piazza ed ecco che...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}... a un tratto mi sono venute
in mente{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tutte le cose che sono
successe{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} qui {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}}.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Quell'albero{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} deve averne viste
di cotte e di crude, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La prossima volta che ti va
di fare un tuffo nel passato,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
dovresti provare a sederti lì!
DE:
Ich saß neulich unter dem {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Baum
auf unserem Festplatz{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Und plötzlich fielen mir alle
möglichen Sachen wieder ein,
die in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} passiert sind!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Dieser Baum hat echt eine ganze
Menge erlebt, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn du mal in alten Erinnerungen
schwelgen willst, dann setz dich
einfach mal da hin!
TRANSLATION:
Plazadaki ağacın önünde
oturuyordum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Birden{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tonla şeyin{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}},
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} kasabasında yaşananların,
anısı üstüme geldi.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}O ağaç{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hayatı boyunca neler görmüştür
kim bilir, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir gün kafa
dinlemek istersen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} orada oturmayı dene!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}When I looked closely at a
mushroom I found,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I noticed that it
was actually mushroom furniture!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mushroom furniture is cool, I guess.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}But I was really hoping for
something edible, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Al fijarme bien en una seta que
me encontré,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡me di cuenta de
que en realidad era un mueble!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Los muebles de la serie hongo
molan, sí... {{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡Pero yo lo que quería
era algo comestible, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Une fois j'ai trouvé un gros
champignon, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mais en le regardant de plus près, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}je
me suis rendu compte qu'en fait
c'était un meuble champignon !
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}J'aime bien les meubles champignon.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mais j'aurais nettement préféré
un champignon qui se mange !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Osservando attentamente un fungo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
mi sono reso conto che in realtà
era un mobile, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I mobili a forma di fungo saranno
belli finché vuoi,{{TAG:0003:0024:}} ma speravo di
aver trovato qualcosa da mangiare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ich hab neulich einen Pilz gefunden,
aber als ich genauer hingeguckt hab,
war das ein Möbelstück!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Auch nicht schlecht.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}} Aber eigentlich
hatte ich mich auf ein leckeres
Pilzgericht gefreut,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

aslında mantar şeklinde bir mobilya

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mantar mobilyası güzel de...

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Do you have a {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}wet suit{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sometimes they have them for sale
on the island.
If you have one of those,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} you can
swim in the ocean year round!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
That'd be so nice, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}I mean, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}there's all sorts of stuff in
the ocean that's good for eating,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}And there are no limits on how
much you can catch,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} so you can
have yourself a real gorgefest.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Tienes un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}traje de buceo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}A veces
los venden en la isla.
Si tienes uno,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡puedes nadar
en el mar todo el año!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿A que estaría bien, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Lo digo porque {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}en el mar hay
muchas cosas que están riquísimas
y que no me importaría zamparme...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Y puedes estar cogiendo lo que
quieras hasta cansarte,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} así que
imagina qué cena puedes montarte.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Est-ce que tu as un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}maillot{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Des fois, ils en vendent sur l'île.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Avec ça, tu peux passer ton temps à
nager dans la mer, tu sais.
Ça peut être carrément sympa, ça,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Je veux dire, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}il y a plein de trucs
cool dans l'eau.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Surtout des trucs à
manger.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Et tu peux en attraper autant que tu
veux, tu n'es pas limité{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est pas
cool, ça ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu ce l'hai una {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}muta{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A volte le trovi in vendita sull'isola.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Se hai una muta,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} puoi fare
immersioni tutto l'anno!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Non sarebbe bello, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Con tutte quelle cose così buone
da mangiare che si trovano in fondo
al mare, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E puoi acchiappare tutto quello
che ti pare e piace{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} per rimpinzarti
con un'abbuffata colossale.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hast du einen {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Taucheranzug{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Anscheinend kann man
die manchmal auf der Insel kaufen.
Mit so einem Anzug kann man
tauchen gehen, wann man will.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Das wär so toll,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Im Meer gibt's echt 'ne ganze
Menge interessanter Sachen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Und man kann davon sammeln,
so viel man will!
